name: Luke Riley
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: An unbeaten English featherweight from Next Generation Liverpool (14-0, age 27), a Paddy Pimblett teammate. 3-0 in the UFC: a R2 knockout of Bogdan Grad (bonus), a decision over Michael Aswell and a R1 knockout of Kai Kamaka III in July. Added two weeks out.

how_they_fight.Striking: Ten knockouts: five in R1, four in R2, one in R3.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Four decision wins; can go three rounds.

news.text: Added to UFC Saudi Arabia two weeks out against Gabriel Santos.

sources.title: Late UFC Saudi Arabia Addition Could Steal "Fight of the Night" Honors
